headline: Chile Regulator CMF Requests Expanded Powers Over Private Investment Funds
summary: Catherine Tornel, president of Chile's Financial Market Commission (CMF), requested expanded statutory powers to supervise private investment funds. The proposal follows regulatory lessons learned from the financial scandal involving Sartor.
why: The Financial Market Commission (CMF) supervises securities, insurance, and banking markets in Chile.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: Chile's financial regulator requested stronger oversight over private investment funds.
